about_the_game:
Awaken in a body that isn’t yours.

You open your eyes in a sterile chamber. A cheerful scientist greets you like an old friend. She welcomes you to your new existence as you struggle to remember. You are no longer human. You are Soulfused: a consciousness wired into a robotic shell, forged to serve an Empire that demands obedience.

As you begin your service, you'll navigate a world where the Empire's iron grip has extinguished almost all resistance. Yet, whispers of rebellion persist in the shadows.  Soon you find yourself torn between loyalty, morality, and self-rediscovery.

Will you obey? Will you resist? Or will you discover something deeper about yourself and the world that made you?

A Modern Text Adventure

Soulfused re-imagines classic text adventures with modern conveniences. Every action is a typed command. From navigating rooms to battling enemies, your words shape your journey.

  • Choices matter: The choices you make determine your path. Will you chose loyalty over morality? Or will you prioritize rediscovering who you were?

  • Combat & leveling: Engage in turn based combat inspired by RPG games. Build your own Soulfused path and unlock new abilities as you grow.

  • Streamlined typing: Type with ease using shortcuts, context-aware commands, tab completion, and input history. All designed to keep the action flowing and the experience effortless.

Explore a Dystopian World

Venture beyond the walls of the conversion chamber into a oppressive Empire. From your Hub you'll take on missions that will send you out into the field. Each mission takes you to a new location within its borders, from dark and dusty industrial cities to quiet, abandoned facilities haunted by the remnants of rebellion.

Meet characters with their own agendas, secrets, and loyalties. Will you help those who resist, serve those who rebuilt you, or go back to discover who you were?

Explore the world and meet its people. How will you leave your mark?

short_description: Soulfused is a modern take on the classic text adventures from the early days of computer gaming. Dive into a dystopian future ruled by an empire focused on conquest and control. Take on the role of a newly converted Soulfused; a part human/part robot soldier in service to the Empire.
